description: Establish the baseline and add a shared credential-gating helper. Confirm the project builds, all 2711 tests pass, and depcruise is clean before any changes. Then add a small env-gating utility (used by later features) that resolves connector credentials from environment variables with a fail-loud-in-prod / fall-back-to-mock-in-local-or-test policy.
steps: Run setup and confirm baseline (build, 2711 tests, depcruise).
Add env-gating helper resolving Shopify + Razorpay creds from env with prod-like fail-loud / local fall-back-to-null policy.
Add unit tests requiring no real credentials.
acceptance_criteria: pnpm build succeeds; pnpm test >= 2711; pnpm depcruise clean.
Helper returns null (mock fallback) when creds absent in local/test; throws named error when absent in prod-like env.
findings: DONE (commit 3e0f75d). Added apps/worker/src/connector-env.ts (resolveShopifyCredentials, resolveRazorpayCredentials, isProdLike, requireShopifyCredentials, requireRazorpayCredentials) + 20 unit tests in connector-env.test.ts. Placed under apps/worker/src (app may import packages; only worker + scripts consume it) to keep depcruise green (2038 modules, no violations). Helpers take an injected env bag rather than reading process.env globally. Verified: build passes, pnpm test 2731 passing (2711 + 20), depcruise clean. IMPORTANT ENV NOTE for later features: in this sandbox, fs_write/read_file operate on a per-turn snapshot overlay while bash/git/pnpm/vitest operate on the real /root/counterX disk. Source files created via fs_write must be copied onto the real disk (bash cp) before the toolchain sees them; prefer writing source files with bash heredoc or ensure copy-to-disk. Task-state .agents files must be written to the real disk via bash.
